items.headline: Highlight: No. 8 LSU shakes off turnovers, surges past Louisiana Tech
items.description: Sam Leavitt accounts for four touchdowns as the Tigers overcome four turnovers and pull away in the second half for a 45-14 win ahead of their showdown with Ole Miss.

items.headline: No. 8 LSU and QB Sam Leavitt overcome a rash of turnovers in a 45-14 victory over Louisiana Tech
items.description: — Sam Leavitt overcame three interceptions with three touchdown runs, and No. 8 LSU pulled away in the second half for a 45-14 victory over a Louisiana Tech team that gave the Tigers fits for the better part of their match-up Saturday night.
